items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: that Jones Jones used a lot?

ctx.x: Well, the musicians from around up here in the mountain, besides the hotel and a lot of people, they came in and played and, you know, saying a few good words to make me feel good, had a little dinner, you know, and had a little jam session and all that. You know, all around (inaudible). After that, then they played, it was for maybe one more night. I went out and they had it in another club out there at the racetrack here. So, I went out and joined them out there and it was for me. And then, they was, wanted to…

Right. And, a little while back, too, you mentioned that you also worked as a quartet for awhile. You know, was that similar in any way to the type of quartet form, let's say, that Jones Jones used a lot?
Well, I guess it would, in members, that's all. It was like a rhythm section and myself.
